events.verdict: The ball is last touched by Cauley-Stein (SAC).
Hield (SAC) maintains a legal guarding position during the jump shot attempt by Jackson (PHX).
Jackson (PHX) brings two hands to the opposite side of Cauley-Stein's (SAC) body but removes them as Cauley-Stein moves away.
[Observable in Enhanced Video] Bogdanovic (SAC) slides his pivot foot at the start of his dribble.
LLB shows that prior to the blocked shot, Oubre Jr. (PHX) reaches in and makes contact to the arm of Bogdanovic (SAC) during his shooting motion that affects his driving shot attempt.
Ayton (PHX) establishes himself in a screening position in the path of Jackson (SAC) and doesn't deliver contact.
Hield (SAC) maintains a legal guarding position during the jump shot attempt by Oubre Jr. (PHX).
Cauley-Stein (SAC) makes contact to the arm of Oubre Jr. (PHX) during his shooting motion that affects his play at the basket.
Melton (PHX) reaches his arm across the torso of Fox and affects his SQBR.
Ayton (PHX) establishes himself in a screening position in the path of Jackson (SAC) and doesn't deliver contact.
Fox (SAC) maintains a legal guarding position during the jump shot attempt by Warren (PHX).
Holmes (PHX) commits a take foul on Cauley-Stein (SAC).
Jackson (SAC) commits a take foul on Ayton (PHX).
